cases.purpose: native-protocol-requires-server r3: stock-observed protocol-27 delta against the original existing basis
cases.candidate_script:
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LC_ALL=C
H=/tmp/parity-case/rsync-delta-wire-adapter
builtin rsync --native --rsync-path /usr/bin/rsync -a -v -e "$H" source/ fixture:remote/dest/ > "$HOME/delta-client.stdout" 2> "$HOME/delta-client.stderr"
rc=$?
"$H" observe "$rc"
cases.reference_script:
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LC_ALL=C
H=/tmp/parity-case/rsync-delta-wire-adapter
/usr/bin/rsync --protocol=27 -a -v -e "$H" source/ fixture:remote/dest/ > "$HOME/delta-client.stdout" 2> "$HOME/delta-client.stderr"
rc=$?
"$H" observe "$rc"
cases.stdout:
status=0
protocol-27=1
basis=1
delta-copy=1
bytes-identical=1
peer-stage=observed
cases.comparison: Exact result bytes and full workspace tree; bounded bidirectional raw wire, stock receiver DELTASUM3 block events and unique event-matching token slice are retained independently of client logging. Observer uncertainty is held, even if the framework reports FAIL.
cases.oracle: Stock rsync client and stock receiver in the disposable guest establish a positive basis-block delta control and a whole-file literal control; the stock receiver reports decoded block indexes. No network or authentication claim.
